description: This Java class 'RemoveUnneededTraces' processes PCB layout files to identify and remove unused segments and vias, optimizing the PCB design by eliminating unnecessary traces and vias.

classes.name: RemoveUnneededTraces
classes.description: A utility class for optimizing PCB layout files by removing unused traces and vias.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for command-line execution. Expects input and output file paths.

methods.name: optimize
methods.description: Loads the PCB layout from a file, removes unused segments and vias, and writes back to the output file.

methods.name: removeUnusedVias
methods.description: Removes vias that are not connected to any segment in the layout.

methods.name: findUnusedVias
methods.description: Finds vias that are unused based on their connectivity.

methods.name: removeUnusedSegments
methods.description: Removes segments from the layout that are not connected to any via or module.

methods.name: findUnusedSegments
methods.description: Identifies segments that are unused by analyzing their connectivity.

methods.name: isUnused
methods.description: Determines if a segment is unused based on connection points and other segments/modules.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if a point is connected to other segments or modules.
